scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.setup: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/db exec drizzle-kit push
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "cross-env PORT=8080 NODE_ENV=development node --env-file=.env --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs" "cross-env PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/vibescan dev"
